text:
sophie: heads up — Acme Corp (acct AC-9842) just pinged us. Invoice INV-2025-998 was paid on 2026-07-05 but it does NOT contain their PO number (PO: PO-5543). AP team refuses to accept the PDF without PO. customer added PO to account after payment. can we reissue or do credit+rebill? :grimacing:
mike: thx. quick clarifying q: was the invoice issued under the correct legal entity / VAT? sometimes AP needs different entity on invoice, which forces a reissue with different tax lines.
sophie: good call — legal entity on invoice = "Redwood Inc."; customer needs it to show "Redwood EU Ltd" (their AP flagged VAT registration mismatch). so we need a new invoice with PO and correct entity/tax. payment already captured via card.
eli: short technical note: our invoices service writes invoice.metadata.po at creation from the order payload. it doesn't backfill when account.metadata.po is updated later. repro steps I used:
```
GET /internal/v1/invoices/INV-2025-998
-> payload.invoice.metadata.po == null
GET /internal/v1/customers/AC-9842
-> payload.customer.metadata.po == "PO-5543"
```
so the system behaved as expected.
mike: ok. proposed ops workflow (finance-owned):
1) create a full credit note for INV-2025-998 (reason: issued without PO / wrong entity). link credit to customer and mark as refunded if we need to return funds.
2) create new invoice INV-2026-1001 under Redwood EU Ltd with correct VAT lines and include PO: PO-5543 in invoice metadata and PDF.
3) apply payment to the new invoice: either a) reapply the captured funds (if possible) or b) if refunded, collect payment via saved card / manual payment. finance to confirm which path they prefer.
4) upload both credit note and new invoice PDFs to customer portal and email AP contact. include a short explanation note for their records.
5) if payment flow changes tax treatment, loop in tax@ and accounting for journal entries.

eli: technical backing steps I can do to make the reissue smoother:
- add a one-time script to copy invoice.metadata.po <- customer.metadata.po for invoices created in the last 30 days where metadata.po is null (so the new invoice will contain PO).
- small fix for long-term: when account.metadata.po exists we should include it at invoice generation time; will open a tiny PR but this won't help retro invoices.

raj: I can get customer sign-off for the credit/rebill flow and confirm whether they want us to reapply the captured card or accept a refund + new charge. I'll also confirm preferred invoice email and AP contact.
mike: finance question — do we prefer refund+rebill or reapply? Refund+rebill is cleaner for VAT reissuance but adds card fees/refunds. reapply may require manual allocation. finance, pls advise. @billing-bot: create ticket FIN-INV-1776543210 and assign to @mike.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-INV-1776543210 created and assigned to mike. SLA: 3 business days.
sophie: thanks all. I'll mark this P1 for visibility and keep customer updated: "we're issuing a credit and will send a corrected invoice with PO and updated VAT entity within 48-72 hours".
mike: action items:
- mike: coordinate credit note + new invoice with finance (owner)
- eli: prepare one-time script + small PR for long-term fix (blocker removal)
- raj: confirm customer preference for payment handling and AP contact
- sophie: update ticket and customer comms
expected ETA: credit created + new invoice issued within 2 business days after finance confirms path. if refund required and re-charge needed, allow 3 business days for reconciliation.
sophie: attaching relevant IDs: PAYMENT-ID: pay_7F3f2X, gateway_ref: stripe_ch_1GxZ, original invoice pdf stored at /internal/files/invoices/INV-2025-998.pdf
eli: I'll prep the SQL for the one-time fix and drop it into the ticket. sample SQL:
```
UPDATE invoices i
SET metadata = jsonb_set(i.metadata, '{po}', to_jsonb(c.metadata->>'po'))
FROM customers c
WHERE i.customer_id = c.id
  AND i.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND (i.metadata->>'po') IS NULL
  AND c.metadata->>'po' IS NOT NULL;
```
mike: perfect. if finance needs a manual journal, @eli please export the invoice + credit note numbers.
raj: I'll get AP contact and confirm whether PDF signature blocks need to include PO on top-right.
sophie: marking resolved once FIN ticket is done. will follow up in this thread. :white_check_mark:
